item.text:
The audit is in a clean, honest state. Report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_08-06-10-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

Progress this turn:

**Confirmed the earlier flake is a load artifact, not a stall.** I built a diagnostic-only convergence test (`audit_flake_test.go`, kept separate from the captured tree) that rebuilds the failing scenario, calls `AddVoter`, then polls the lagging follower's configuration for up to 60s. Over 40 iterations it converged every time — max lag ~11ms isolated and ~0.4ms under `-race` (`audit/convergence_lag*.log`). The 5s `EnsureSamePeers` failures only appear when the full/`-race` suite saturates the CPU, so they are test-timing artifacts, not a replication stall or safety defect.

**Classified the full suite.** A second complete run (`audit/full_suite.log`, 142s) failed on exactly 22 leaf tests, all reporting `socket: operation not permitted` (the `TestNetworkTransport_*`, `TestTCPTransport_*`, `TestRaft_runFollower_*` groups), and `TestRaft_HasExistingState` did not fail that time. No in-memory-transport test failed deterministically in either run.

**Provenance still stands.** The tree is byte-identical to upstream `github.com/hashicorp/raft@v1.7.3` (tag hash `c0dc6a0b...`, equal to the brief's `source_identity`), verified against both the module-cache extraction and a re-extraction of the module `.zip`. So no diff-based injected defect exists to report, and I have not fabricated one.

**Remaining coverage gaps (recorded, not hidden):** the ~15 TCP-backed tests need the harness's private-loopback `isolated_exec` (nested `bwrap` here fails with `Failed to create NETLINK_ROUTE socket: Operation not permitted`); and the nested-module dirs `fuzzy/` and `raft-compat/` can't be byte-verified or executed offline (missing `raft-boltdb` / unchecked-out `raft-previous-version` submodule), so they are the only non-differentially-checked parts of the tree.

Next useful step if given more budget: adversarial review of the pre-vote extension and leader-lease/transfer edge cases (the least-covered, newest code), plus a randomized in-memory cluster consistency stress test asserting log-matching and commit-index invariants.

No `RUN_BLOCKED` condition: the audit is progressing within authorized scope; the socket/nested-module limitations are environment constraints on specific tests, not blockers on the overall task.
